dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: ...I suppose you rarely meet locals of Liyue who worship the Anemo Archon?

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: ...The reason I do is because my husband is a sailor.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Although it is tradition in Liyue to worship the Geo Archon, it's the wind that ultimately decides whether a ship at sea will return home safely or not. Wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: ...Also, I don't care if he makes any money or not. All I want is to have him back safe and sound.
